audience: facilities and IT teams that track assets, check them out and keep their maintenance records in AssetTiger

useCases.title: Find the assets checked out to a person
useCases.text: List the persons, then list the assets filtered by person. Open an asset to see its current event and custom fields.

useCases.title: Read the events and history of an asset
useCases.text: List the events of one asset, such as check-outs, repairs and losses. Read its change history between two dates.

useCases.title: Review maintenance by site and location
useCases.text: List the sites, then the locations inside one site. List the maintenance records for that site or location.

useCases.title: Check an asset out to a person or customer
useCases.text: Check an asset out to a person, a customer or a site and location. No email goes out unless sendEmail is true.

useCases.title: Register a new asset
useCases.text: Create one asset with its asset tag id and description. Each call makes a new record, so search for the asset first.
